prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1476; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a collision in which our client was struck by another vehicle while turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of the impact and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, together with a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the accident. Please also confirm whether any other policies, including umbrella or excess coverage, may apply.

Your insured and your company have a duty to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics footage, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster files, repair estimates, and any communications with third parties. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.
